release_rule: Every material predecessor finding must have an explicit successor disposition. MORE_TESTING_REQUIRED blocks release until resolved or explicitly DEFER_TO_LATER_GENERATION under a non-material/deferred scope; validated improvements accumulate across generations.

components.rationale: Kraken Spot EUR remains execution-price, fill-realism and live tradability truth.
Current public Kraken AssetPairs online Spot-EUR universe is the operational live tradability source; no static whitelist.
Point-in-time timestamps, no future leakage, sealed holdout, trial ledger and search accounting are strategy-independent research safeguards.
Small deterministic/E2E proof before scale is a permanent release and research rule.
Unique-value source intake, authority boundaries, no silent duplicate raw storage and bounded retention remain mandatory.
Content-addressed protected-code/config rollback without whole-repo evidence rewind is a permanent release safeguard.
Feed freshness, operational taxonomy, bounded self-heal, independent cloud fallback and no stale decisions are infrastructure invariants.

MAE/MFE, follow-up horizons, post-detection continuation and timing decomposition remain inherited measurement requirements. Batch 002 additionally proves that temporally adjacent mature cohorts can have materially different 24h close/MAE profiles; the V2R3 final audit and later H4/H7 work must therefore preserve observation-window/regime stratification rather than pooling blindly.

Clean V2R3 now has 768 outcomes but only 1 BUY_SCOUT/1 completed trade; 566 cases are mature to 24h with HEALTHY integrity. Low conversion and later REJECT MFE are material successor evidence, but final filter dispositions still wait for the clean-series completion review and realistic path/cost reconstruction.

At Batch 002 the clean series had 712 revalidations; median extra TTL lag was about 337s and p90 about 1,210s, while trade conversion remained 1/768. This confirms a separate timing/runtime problem but does not explain the full strategy/filter selectivity. Final classification remains gated by the V2R3 review; V2R4's inactive bounded-WAIT/fresh-recheck path already covers the successor mechanism.

components.source_version: V2R4 historical prep (superseded PR #9 module evidence)
components.rationale: Kraken-fresh recheck with optional Altrady wakeup is technically proven by historical superseded-PR module evidence, but the final V2R4 candidate must be rebuilt from cleaned current main and complete separate prospective V2R4 Paper evidence.
Two-stage scout/confirmation must be judged on clean prospective net edge and timing, not assumed permanent.

Batch 002 strengthens anti-chase: already-run cases retained higher MFE but worse MAE and no better 24h close. Immediate chase relaxation is not supported; only a separately versioned pullback/rebuild/second-leg hypothesis remains eligible for later prospective testing.

The clean series now has 566 mature 24h candidate paths, enough for descriptive temporal/regime MAE/MFE analysis, but only 1 completed trade, which is insufficient to calibrate stop/TTL/exit parameters or infer net trade performance. Keep the preregistered H4 branch blocked until final V2R3 review and a frozen point-in-time regime definition.

The first full V2R4 Paper series is now bindingly fixed at the inherited V2R3 sizing of 50 EUR scout + 50 EUR stage 2 so timing/discovery/revalidation is isolated. Adaptive setup-quality sizing is excluded from that release and remains a separately versioned later research experiment.
0.60% taker/side remains conservative reference, but spread/slippage/re-entry/fill realism still require targeted evidence.

Kraken Futures H2 research tooling remains isolated/unattached. Separately, Binance public connectivity on the MINI-PC is now physically proven HEALTHY for spot server time, BTCUSDT premium/funding and open interest without API key/account/orders. Binance remains supplementary only.

WS reconciliation/state capture and physical MINI-PC smoke are proven. Replacement prospective trial V3-H3-ASSOC-002 fixed only the technical scheduler bug. Four valid >=1800s MINI-PC sessions across two UTC dates matured the frozen collection gate with BTC=1252, ETH=1314, SOL=1331 valid rows. Fixed descriptive association evaluation PASS and canonical import PASS. Associations are feature/symbol/horizon-specific rather than a universal cross-symbol direction; no threshold, feature-transform, pair or horizon search was performed.

FOMC calendar/DST/known-at methodology is green and exactly one 30m-before/30m-after FOMC statement no-new-entry RISK_GATE variant is preregistered. It is not running and cannot be materialized until the final inherited baseline is frozen.

Hyperliquid public read-only transport/response shape is green. No trader-quality, wallet-selection or predictive-value claim exists. This branch is not required for the first V3 shadow unless explicitly selected later.

Polymarket public read-only discovery/CLOB transport is green. Two identical-code bounded captures proved order-book state changes are observable; no predictive value, crypto direction or surprise-score validity is proven. This branch is not required for the first V3 shadow unless explicitly selected later.
Preregistered H1 was insufficient and distinct H2 failed its development gate; sealed 2026H1 holdout remained unopened. Do not resurrect via silent parameter search.
Current project path explicitly excludes leverage; V3 research is not authorized to introduce it.

Exact V3-H1-INCR-001 MINI-PC report is imported and the fixed review is complete with holdout sealed. The preregistered relative-context features retain small but sign-consistent incremental partial association after controlling target 1h return across research_train/calibration/validation and both weighting schemes. No threshold search, winner selection or promotion was performed.

Exact V3-H6-INCR-001 MINI-PC report is imported and the fixed review is complete with holdout sealed. Incremental volume contribution conditional on fixed price-direction strata is small/near zero; partial-correlation signs are internally consistent by stratum but simple effects are not uniformly sign-stable. No threshold/transform search, winner selection or promotion was performed.

The H6 incremental physical report is imported and fixed quantitative review is complete. Incremental volume contribution beyond fixed price direction is small/near zero in the preregistered development splits; no retuning or holdout access occurred.
Meta TAKE/NO-TAKE training is blocked until V2R3 final review and a point-in-time label/cost/split contract are frozen. Current label readiness is explicitly NOT_FROZEN.

Two distinct EOD known-at cycles and one bounded prospective state capture are green. Coverage remains heterogeneous (4 returned / SOL missing), retrieved_at is the conservative prospective known-at bound, and no historical backfill/outcome join/threshold/schedule is authorized.

Book+trade public clock is cloud/physical green. Kraken's current public standard spot fee schedule is versioned, but the account-specific tier is deliberately unverified and must not be guessed. Fill/routing modelling remains blocked pending account-tier evidence plus fixed deadline/cleanup and explicit queue assumptions.
